question.quote: When our bodies come most alive, why should the skincare our skin feels stay ordinary?
question.body: The beauty market sat at two extremes. Conventional cosmetics chased polish but felt heavy through a day of movement, while sports formulas shouted function and gave up the comfort and refinement skin deserves.
question.naming: AVORA joins the A of Athlete and Active with Vitality & Aura — the clear energy and poise that come from skin in good condition.

philosophy.quote: Movement is the purest, most powerful expression of being alive. From an easy walk at dawn to the moment you take hold of the day, AVORA stays out of the way and lets skin find its own texture.
philosophy.body: Right after you have moved hard, AVORA meets your skin with a precise, unhurried softness. That reversal is what makes it ours.

items.q: What kind of brand is AVORA?
items.a: AVORA is an active lifestyle skincare brand for people in their twenties and thirties who move often. The name joins the A of Athlete and Active with Vitality & Aura. It is not a sports-only brand — it is made for anyone who moves.

items.q: What is the SPF rating of Daily Sunscreen?
items.a: SPF50+ / PA++++, the highest grade under Korean standards, designed for long stretches of outdoor activity.

items.q: Can I wear it while working out?
items.a: Yes. It is designed toward a water-resistant formula that holds through sweat, with a light finish that does not interfere with movement. If you have been sweating heavily, reapply before the two-hour mark.

items.q: Does it leave a white cast?
items.a: Minimising white cast is one of the core design goals. The target is a watery gel with no white cast; the final formula is confirmed through sensory evaluation.
It is designed toward fragrance-free, with artificial scent and colour kept to a minimum, and is intended to work for anyone regardless of gender.

support.heading: Support
support.intro: Common questions about ordering and shipping. Where something is not settled yet, we say so.

signup.q: Do I need an account to order?
signup.aGuest: No. You can order without creating an account. Afterwards you can check your delivery with your order number and phone number.
signup.aMember: You can order without an account. If you order as a member, your past orders are kept together on your account page.

lookup.q: Where can I see my order?
lookup.a: On the order lookup page, using your order number and the phone number you entered when ordering.

countries.a: Right now you can order only in {countries}. Elsewhere the site shows the brand and the product without a buy option.

fee.provisional: This is a starting point, not a settled policy. Once it is settled, this page and the checkout change together.

tracking.q: How do I track a shipment?
tracking.a: Once an order ships, the carrier and tracking number appear on the order lookup page. Use that number with the carrier to see where the parcel is.

privacy.q: What happens to the details I enter when ordering?
privacy.a: We take only what delivery needs. Card and bank details never reach our servers — they stay inside the payment provider. What we collect and how long we keep it is set out in the privacy policy.

pending.heading: What we cannot answer yet
pending.body: Delivery times, payment methods and exchange or return conditions are not decided yet. We would rather leave them blank than write down something unsettled. They go up here as soon as they are fixed.
